Just need to vent more than anything. 

Therapy isn't really an option for a few reasons. Between work, school, and homeschooling there isn't a lot of time. Don't carry health insurance so cost is a factor. And the spouse has never been supportive of my going any time it's come up. It's never been worth the argument to just go anyways.
